newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher in quiet, cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher in quiet, cautious trade.

text.p: UK shares started moderately higher, underpinned by firmer bonds but trading volumes were light as investors remained wary of Wall Street following the Dow's 71-point sell-off on Wednesday.

The FTSE 100 index, which dropped 53 points on Wednesday, opened 5.3 points higher at 3,987.0. Trading volume was a meagre 15 million shares by the 0830 GMT open, reflecting the market's nervousness over a possible sharp correction for U.S. shares, dealers said.
"A lot of people believe the Dow is headed south (lower)," one senior trader said."
